title: Assemble the ordinary model Hom maps naturally
statement: For a specified NativeFrobeniusRingedModel A [lem-sf-native-frobenius-ringed-model], there exists a natural isomorphism from ringed internal Hom followed by A.E to ordinary adic internal Hom after A.E on both variables, whose component at (M,N) is precisely A.hom(M,N).hom.

source.place: Ordinary Hom naturality of the native Frobenius ringed model.

proof.text: Apply NatIso.ofComponents to A.hom. The bifunctorial naturality equation is exactly A.hom_naturality for the contravariant source map and covariant target map. The component normalization is reflexivity.

lean.statement:
theorem normalized_ordinary_hom
    {k₀ : Type u} [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    (A : NativeFrobeniusRingedModel k₀ l X) :
    ∃ h : Functor.uncurry.obj (SheafOfModules.homFunctor (R := A.R)) ⋙ A.E.functor ≅
        (A.E.functor.op.prod A.E.functor) ⋙ Functor.uncurry.obj
          (ordinaryIhomBifunctor l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber),
      ∀ M N, h.hom.app (op M, N) = (A.hom M N).hom
